                                  PREFACE
      This book is the outgrowth of a need revealed by the every day experi-
ences of the editors in the social , fraternal , advertising , and merchandising
fields . Even before engaging in the advertising business , they found , from
time to time that they required certain information regarding the Jewish
population of the United States . To their surprise they found that there was
no standard reference book from which such information could be secured .
      Part of the data required was scattered through a number of volumes ;
part required independent research . At the cost of considerable time and
expense they collected the unpublished information     for the benefit of their
clients and themselves . After this experience had been repeated several times
they realized that they had the nucleus of a very useful reference work .
     Racial pride and professional esprit de corps . . . the desire to show the
cultural and economical importance of Jewry . . . the wish to give other
advertising men the benefit of this information prompted them to publish
"The National Jewish Blue Book , " An Elite Directory .
     At the outset , they were not ambitious for this work as other important
interests made imperative demands on their time and attention . They merely
proposed to produce a carefully compiled volume that would be worthy in
every way of the patronage of their people and the advertising world ; print
a limited edition ; and leave it to make its own way in the world .
     In pursuance of this arrangement , they had the contents carefully
                                                                   col-
lated and checked and ordered a limited edition from Haddon Craftsmen ,
publishers of the American Mercury and the famous Borzoi books .
     At the outset , they had no idea of including any advertising in this volume ,
but the mere announcement of its publication brought in requests for several
pages , and such advertisements as appear in the first edition are mainly the
result of natural demand .
    All this proved to the publishers that "The National Jewish Blue Book"
(An Elite Directory ) was an even more valuable reference book and selling
medium than they had thought .
    Men of standing in the advertising world told them it was a Great Mer-
chandising Atlas . . . that they marveled no one had hit upon the idea before .
    Professional friends assured them that it was a very valuable Reference
Work . . . indispensable to the physician , dentist , lawyer , and indeed to any
one who comes in contact with people of the Jewish race .
    Hostesses of high social standing expiated on its value as a Social
Register .
    Such , in brief , is the story of the Genesis of "The National Jewish Blue
Book . "
                                        15
16                      THE NATIONAL JEWISH BLUE BOOK

     The publishers recognize that the standards for inclusion in this book
are arbitrary . They realize the future may acclaim some obscure figures as
the very elite of Jewry . However , this book deals with the present , and it was
necessary to compile it from the best information at hand to - day .
   WEALTH , as indicated by memberships in country and social clubs ;
EDUCATION , as indicated by professional degrees and memberships in
fraternities and sororities , have been the standards used .
     It  might be well to assure subscribers that no financial     considerations
were involved in the compilation of this work . A Reference Book is necessarily
devoted to cold , hard facts and not to flattering comments regarding any indi-
vidual .     No one has paid     a penny to have his or her name included   in this
volume .
    It has not been possible to get full information regarding memberships in
every organization , but such instances have been relatively rare .
    The difficulties that have arisen in securing information have mainly
grown from the fact that secretaries and other officers of organizations have ,
very properly , desired reassurance as to the purpose for which the information
was required .  Of course , this difficulty will not recur after the first edition
has actually been put on the market .
    In conclusion , the publishers wish to extend their heartiest thanks to all
who have cooperated in the compilation of " The National Jewish Blue Book . ”
They wish to assure the subscribers that all possible diligence and care has
been used in compiling it , and that for the most part the few inaccuracies are
the results of circumstances beyond their control .
     They intend to make "The National Jewish Blue Book " an institution
of which every Jew can be proud and to increase its usefulness to the highest
degree     possible .
     Next year will see a much finer and more valuable volume , containing
additional     information   .
                                                                 The Editors
                            INTRODUCTION
                              By FRANCIS     ODONE


    Subscribers to the National Jewish Blue Book may feel a certain surprise
at a Gentile being selected to write the introduction .    I
                                                       was surprised when
the Jewish editors requested me to do so , and suggested       that they secure the
services of some eminent Jewish scholar .
    " No ," they answered . " Jewish people will be interested in the reaction
of an outsider to this work ."
     The most marvelous thing regarding "The National Jewish Blue Book ,"
An Elite Directory , is that no one thought of publishing such a Reference
Work before .
     Certainly the Jew is a subject of interest to everyone no matter what his
social standing . . . tastes . . . business . . . or profession , because there is
not a human being in the world today who does not come in contact with him .
     This is especially true of the United States where nearly one quarter of
all the Jews in the world are domiciled .
     Nearly 4,000,000 American citizens ; shrewd . . progressive . . . and
highly intelligent ; of every possible degree of culture ; comprising a very high
proportion of professional men and well - to - do people . Here are the wealthy
and influential ; the very cream of them scientifically listed and classified .
     Are you a writer ? No people have a more interesting cultural background
than the Jews .
     Are you a Scientist ?
     Whose names rank higher than Garrel , Steinmetz or Millikan ?
     Are you interested in social work ?
     What people have given more lavishly to philanthropies ?
     Are you interested in art or belles lettres ?
     Here again the Jew has a substantial record of achievement .
     Finally and most important , are you interested in making a living ?
    As a financier and merchant , the Jew holds a place second to none .

                                              -
    Yet , there has never been a systematic listing and classification of our
Jewish population . What advertising man what merchandising man hasn't
needed this volume every week in the year ?
    Is it worth while to consider Jewish people as a race ?
    Yes , for the Jew is unique in the fact that he has preserved his racial
integrity for five thousand years through more vicissitudes and hardships.
than have befallen any race in the whole history of the world .
    Pliant and adaptable in many respects , he has always shown bull - dog
tenacity in maintaining his identity as a Jew .
                                        17
18                   THE NATIONAL JEWISH BLUE BOOK

      Achievements certainly justify his racial pride . Of the other three great
religions of today : Christianity , Mohammedanism , and Buddism , the Jew,
and his racial cousin , the Arab , account for two . In fact , it may be said that
the modern ethical ideas of the entire white race originated in Jewry .
   Jewish contributions to culture are important       enough to rank the    Jew
among the world's great races .
     Spinoza , Heine , Schubert and Mendelssohn are geniuses of whom any race
could be proud .
     Nor must it be forgotten that among the Jew's great services to humanity ,
is the fact that he , and practically he alone , kept commerce and finance alive
during the dark ages , and thus made the renaissance and our modern civiliza-
tion possible .
     With very little encouragement , the Jew has     been   one   of the best of
citizens .
     Coming from countries where for the most part his treatment has been
such as would justify the hating of his fatherland , he usually shows an almost
pathetic patriotism and loyalty .
    American Jews have always been 100 % Americans , always willing and
eager to advance the interests of their country .
    Considering the Jew as a philanthropist , one can scarcely move about
a modern American    city without finding evidence of his quick sympathy and
benevolence .
     He not only takes care of the poor and sick among his own people , but
reaches out to benefit and aid all his fellow citizens .
     Go to the largest of American Universities . There you will find the most
magnificent  collection of " Primitives " in this country in the Fogg Museum ,
presented to his Alma Mater by a Jew .
    The two most valuable gifts of paintings ever received by the Metropoli-
tan Museum of Art in the United States , the Altman and Dreicer collections ,
were both given by Jews .
    The great endowment fund for the promotion of aviation was given by a
Jew , Guggenheim .
    What people have given more lavishly to foundations for the benefit of
our colored citizens ? Or to foundations for public hospitals and research
work in medicine ?
    All together . · a people of great achievements and of great interest to
every one of their fellow citizens .
    The average wealth and buying power of the American Jew is very high .
Jews have always been great buyers of securities and jewelry , and today they
are great buyers of luxury goods of all kinds . And , they are buying more
and more every year .
     As Jewish people become completely Americanized , they become the
greatest spenders in the world . Who gives his children a better education  ...
a more liberal start in life than the wealthy Jew ?
                       THE NATIONAL JEWISH BLUE BOOK                         19



    Whose wife wears finer clothes , or more expensive jewelry ?
    Who lives in a more expensive or richly furnished home ? Who rides in
a finer car ?
    In analyzing the American Jew, it must always be borne in mind that for
the most part he comes from a hard , poverty - stricken environment ; and he is
literally starved for the good things of life .
     He has left the ghetto . . . is moving to fashionable neighborhoods and
suburbs ; losing his foreign accent and manners ; bending all the resources of
 a fertile and vigorous mind to acquire the manners , customs and standards
of living of the very best of his Gentile neighbors .
                   "
      This makes The National Jewish Blue Book " a wonderful selling
medium .
      How can one better appeal to this market than through a volume which
lists every Jew of eminence and achievement in the whole country , and which
goes into the homes and libraries of the very elite of Jewry ; which appeals so
strongly to racial pride ?
     Is this business worth having ?
     Emphatically , yes ! -for the Jew is a highly desirable person with whom
to do business . There is no one who is quicker to appreciate and reciprocate
fair and honest treatment .
     He rates high in commercial honesty . This fact is proven by the statistics
of bonding companies , and the fact that no Jew has ever been implicated as a
principal in any of the great financial scandals which disgrace American
history .
     This volume is extremely comprehensive and complete , and     Ican under-
stand why the editors were years in sifting and compiling the information
contained in this great work before they published the first edition .
    One cannot but admire the skillful manner in which this information has
been systematized . The work is a veritable filing cabinet between two covers
containing a mass of facts for which one would normally have to search
through hundreds and even thousands of channels . It is a wonderful con-
server of time and energy .
     The social register feature is very important , for among Jewish people
 social relations and business relations are often one and the same thing .
      The binding , printing and typography speak for themselves , and prove
 that no expense   has been spared to make this book equal to any directory
 on the market .
     Subscribers should feel grateful to the publishers for putting this book
 out at a price which brings it within reach of everyone .
     Summarizing what has gone before , "The National Jewish Blue Book " is
 the only complete guide to a very interesting and important element in our
 population ; a great business directory and social register , and a wonderful
 selling medium .
